title: Code Repositories in Foundry — When to Embed Python / PySpark in the Pipeline (and When to Stay in Pipeline Builder)
validation_scope: PySpark transform implements seed's worked example: @transform decorator, 3 Inputs, 1 Output, window function for most-recent-sanctions, 90-day adverse-media aggregation, 3 audit-metadata columns.

Pure-Spark variant (compute_counterparty_gold_pure) allows pytest without Foundry runtime; 7 contract tests cover counterparty coverage, sanctions window, out-of-window drop, no-sanctions null, adverse-media density, coalesce-to-zero, audit-metadata + idempotence.
18-criterion decision matrix for Pipeline Builder vs Code Repository.
7-stage CI/CD template with dual-approval gate for gold-layer regulated-ontology writers and post-deploy reconciliation hook connecting to Article 005 TransformChangeEntry.
Performance notes cover production-scale failure modes (skew, partition imbalance, shuffle bloat) with concrete mitigation code and pre-production gate criteria.
known_limits: Portable companion bundle; @transform + Input/Output stubbed for local imports.
CI/CD template is generic GitLab/GitHub CI shape; institution-specific adaptation required.
Performance thresholds (N_SALT, target_partitions) are placeholders; tune per institution dataset shape.
Architecture for > 500M counterparties (streaming aggregation pattern) flagged in performance_notes.md but implemented in Article 008's bundle, not this one.
framing_discipline: The PySpark code is portable Spark; only the @transform decorator + Input/Output API are Foundry-specific. Patterns reusable on Snowflake/Databricks with minor adjustments per Article 010 comparison.
